entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10297 of 2023

Applicant :- Ashish Kumar Srivastava @ Ashish Srivastava
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Jaylaxmi Upadhyay,Ayodhya Prasad Mishra A.P. Mishra,Ayush Shukl
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ayodhya Prasad Mishra, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ambrish Verma, the
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
217 of 2021, under Sections 420, 409 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Gomti Nagar, District
Lucknow.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 01.04.20221 against the applicant describing him as the owner of R.Sons Infraland Developers Pvt. Ltd. and other unknown persons stating that the informant had paid some amount to the aforesaid company for purchasing a plot of land on 15.02.2013 and she paid a total of Rs.3,23,500/- in five installments but thereafter the company's office was closed and the amount paid by the informant was not refunded to her.
4. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant is involved in as many as 118 cases of similar nature and he has been granted bail in 90 cases.

In para 12 and 13 of the affidavit it has been stated that the applicant is ready to settle the dispute after his release and he has given an undertaking that he will settle the Ashish Kumar Srivastava @ Ashish ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31981937/
1 dispute within six months from the date of his release from custody.
5.

entities.text: Ashish Kumar Srivastava @ Ashish ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned A.G.A. has no objection in case the applicant is granted bail, subject to the condition of his fulfilling the undertaking given by him.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since 21.05.2019 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

8. Let the applicant-Ashish Kumar Srivastava @ Ashish Srivastava be released on bail in Case Crime No. 217 of 2021, under Sections 420, 409 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Gomti Nagar, District Lucknow on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of magistrate/court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant will settle the grievance of the informant within a period of six months from the date of his release from custody, failing which this order will stand cancelled automatically after expiry of the aforesaid period.

Order Date :- 18.8.2023 Ram.
